title: Lenny runtime lifecycle events
description: JSON envelopes exchanged on the adapter↔runtime CH-RUNTIMEOPS, a Unix socket distinct from the stdin/stdout JSONL message channel (schemas/lenny-adapter-jsonl.schema.json). Field names are camelCase to match the CH-RUNTIMEOPS message-schema table and the adapter wire (pkg/adapter/runtimeops.go). See spec/28_communication-channels.md §28.5.3, the CH-RUNTIMEOPS card.

lifecycle_capabilities.title: lifecycle_capabilities
lifecycle_capabilities.description: Adapter → runtime, the first frame after the connection handshake. Advertises the lifecycle capabilities the adapter supports. Process-scoped: it carries no sessionId and has no session precondition, while the session-scoped frames the adapter writes for a session follow the session_started that answers the session's session_start on CH-MSGSOCK. The runtime replies with lifecycle_support.

lifecycle_support.title: lifecycle_support
lifecycle_support.description: Runtime → adapter, reply to lifecycle_capabilities. The runtime declares the subset of advertised capabilities it implements.

checkpoint_request.title: checkpoint_request
checkpoint_request.description: Adapter → runtime. Asks the runtime to quiesce the named session's work so the adapter can take a consistent snapshot. The runtime must reply with checkpoint_ready within deadlineMs.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns. A runtime that keeps per-session context drops, without a reply, a frame that names a session it does not hold.

checkpoint_ready.title: checkpoint_ready
checkpoint_ready.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime has quiesced and is ready for the snapshot.

checkpoint_complete.title: checkpoint_complete
checkpoint_complete.description: Adapter → runtime. Confirms the snapshot upload result; the named session's work may resume. reason is present when status is failed.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns. A runtime that keeps per-session context drops, without a reply, a frame that names a session it does not hold.

interrupt_request.title: interrupt_request
interrupt_request.description: Adapter → runtime. Asks the named session's work to reach a safe stop point and the runtime to acknowledge with interrupt_acknowledged within deadlineMs.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns. A runtime that keeps per-session context drops, without a reply, a frame that names a session it does not hold.

interrupt_acknowledged.title: interrupt_acknowledged
interrupt_acknowledged.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime has reached a safe stop point. The original interruptId is echoed.

credentials_rotated.title: credentials_rotated
credentials_rotated.description: Adapter → runtime. New credentials for the named session have been written to credentialsPath. The runtime must rebind that session and reply with credentials_acknowledged.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns. A runtime that keeps per-session context drops, without a reply, a frame that names a session it does not hold.

credentials_acknowledged.title: credentials_acknowledged
credentials_acknowledged.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime has rebound to the new credential. The adapter releases queued LLM requests with the new credential.

deadline_approaching.title: deadline_approaching
deadline_approaching.description: Adapter → runtime. Advance warning before the named session's forced termination. remainingMs is the time left until session expiry or budget exhaustion. A runtime writes no response for the session in reply to this frame when no message for the session is in flight.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns. A runtime that keeps per-session context drops, without a reply, a frame that names a session it does not hold.

files_updated.title: files_updated
files_updated.description: Adapter → runtime. A §7.4 mid-session upload promoted new files into the named session's workspace, `/workspace/slots/{sessionId}/current`. Sent only after the atomic overlay completes, so the runtime never observes partially-written files. The agent re-reads the workspace. One-way: no acknowledgement is expected.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns. A runtime that keeps per-session context drops, without a reply, a frame that names a session it does not hold.

llm_request_started.title: llm_request_started
llm_request_started.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime is about to send an outbound LLM request directly to the provider (direct mode). The adapter increments the in-flight counter for this provider.

llm_request_completed.title: llm_request_completed
llm_request_completed.description: Runtime → adapter. The runtime's outbound LLM request has completed or errored. The adapter decrements the in-flight counter; when it reaches zero and a rotation is pending, the adapter sends credentials_rotated. In direct mode (§11.2) the runtime optionally carries the prompt and completion token counts extracted from the provider response, which the adapter accumulates into the cumulative total of the session sessionId names and reports as the incremental delta since the last read over the §4.7 ReportUsage RPC.

sessionId.description: The session the frame concerns, the session whose request completed. The adapter accumulates the token counts into that session's cumulative total and drops them when the pod holds no binding for that session.
